{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''homeworld''' of the [[Vernol]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was rendered uninhabitable by a [[Meteor/Legends|meteor]] strike fifty years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Because of this, the Vernol moved off [[Planet/Legends|planet]], establishing colonies across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The largest concentration of Vernols settled on the arctic planet of [[Garnib]].
